## Reproduce

```bash
python -u main.py --env windowed --init-weights experiments/atc_run_1_29_pbrs_attn_d/best/best_model.zip --n-envs 8 --critic-warmup-steps 300000 --lr-max 3e-05 --final-lr 3e-06 --ent-coef 0.003 --total-timesteps 5000000

# score: 20-flight and stitched 2x20, 10 attempts, lookahead (100 validation seeds)
python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_32_windowed_ft/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --attempts 9
python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_32_windowed_ft/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --segments 2 --gap 120 900
python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_32_windowed_ft/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --lookahead 4
```
